title: 订单结算与收入核对
context: 销售＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年全部已完成订单，支付成功金额减实际退款，比较净销售金额；输出存在差额的订单。退款本库即退款已支付，支付日期≤年底；失败支付不计。
commonError: 使用所有付款状态或连接拆分付款导致重复。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(amount_cents) paid FROM payments WHERE status='settled' AND payment_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_id), b AS (SELECT i.order_id,SUM(r.refund_cents) refunded FROM returns r JOIN order_items i ON i.order_item_id=r.order_item_id WHERE r.return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY i.order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0) cash_net_cents,COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)-o.net_cents difference_cents FROM v_order_net o LEFT JOIN a ON a.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND COALESCE(a.paid,0)-COALESCE(b.refunded,0)<>o.net_cents ORDER BY o.order_id
